scope: Fresh official-source feature-group inventory, not exhaustive control coverage or runtime certification. runtime_evidence_rule: Advance a target cell only with source/build/driver/target identity, exact operations and authoritative readback from that named target. Fixtures, code graphs, compilation and unrelated old receipts cannot advance these cells.
